Cause: Low pour/die temperature or slow fill; two flow fronts meet without fusing
Identification: Visible line or shallow crack on surface, often far from gate
Correction: Raise melt and die temperature, increase fill rate, improve venting

Cause: Insufficient metal or fill velocity; thin section freezes before complete
Identification: Incomplete part, short fill at extremities and ribs
Correction: Increase wall/runner size, raise velocity, preheat die

Cause: Air or moisture entrapment, turbulent fill, excess lubricant gas
Identification: Round, smooth-walled voids; porous fracture surface
Correction: Reduce entrainment, vacuum assist, control lube, degas melt

Cause: Localized shrinkage away from feeding path in thick sections
Identification: Irregular, dendritic voids at thick sections
Correction: Add feeders, chill thick areas, balance wall thickness

Cause: Constraint during solidification; high-shrinkage alloy at rigid feature
Identification: Crack at corners or rib bases near the gate
Correction: Increase draft, round corners, reduce die constraint

Cause: Alloy welds to die steel at gate or hot spot
Identification: Metal stuck to die, rough local surface transfer
Correction: Adjust die temperature, apply coating, reduce local heat

Cause: Excess metal at parting line; low clamp force or worn shutoff
Identification: Thin fin of metal at the die split line
Correction: Raise clamp tonnage, maintain shutoff, reduce specific pressure

Cause: Subsurface gas expands on heating during plating or paint bake
Identification: Domed bubbles after coating or heat treatment
Correction: Reduce porosity, lower bake temperature, degas melt

Cause: Uneven cooling, residual stress, asymmetric wall sections
Correction: Balance walls and cooling, redistribute ribbing, stress relieve

Cause: Oxide, silicon or foreign particle carried in the melt
Identification: Hard spot or void with embedded particle, machining defect

Cause: High-velocity metal washes and erodes die steel at gate
Identification: Gouged cavity near gate, progressive dimensional growth
Correction: Harden cavity steel, tune velocity, balance gating
